detail.text:

detail.title: Scope - out of scope
detail.text: Offline mode for the driver app (logged as change request CR-03, Phase 2 candidate). SAP integration (owned by Harborline IT). Payroll export.

detail.title: Project overview
detail.text: FleetTrack 2.0 is a rebuild of Harborline Logistics' driver and dispatch platform. Engagement model: time and materials with an approved plan. Start date 3 August 2026. Target go-live 15 February 2027. Team of 9 from our side.

detail.title: Staffing FAQ
detail.text: Adding developers: 2 extra developers would need about 2 weeks of onboarding, so they would only add capacity from mid-January. Realistic gain is about 1 week of buffer. Requires a CR for the additional hours.

detail.title: Known weak spots (and my honest answer)
detail.text:
- Sprint 6 slip: "The demo moved to 4 December because sandbox credentials arrived 9 days late. We have kept go-live and I now flag dependencies a week earlier."
- Crash-free rate below target (99.1% vs 99.5%): "We are fixing the top 3 crash causes in Sprint 7 and will report the rate weekly until UAT."
- Reduced buffer: "Buffer is down to one week, so I will flag any risk to 15 February the same day I see it."

detail.subject: Recap: FleetTrack 2.0 status call and next steps
detail.body:
Hi Megan,

Thank you for the candid conversation today. Here is a quick recap.

Demo slip: The Samsara sandbox credentials arrived November 6 instead of late October, so integration testing started late. The dispatcher demo is now December 4.

February 15: This remains our plan. The buffer has gone from three weeks to one, and I will flag anything early.

Map freezing: We are adding clustering so the map loads only what is on screen, and we will load test it with 1,000 vehicles. The target is December 18, and I will confirm that in writing.

Offline mode: This is outside current scope, so it needs an impact analysis. Usman will send the estimate within three business days.

Security: Usman will get Jason what his security team needs.

Extra developers: I will include this option in the plan, noting the onboarding cost and that it realistically buys about a week.

Next step: I will send you the revised plan by Friday.

Best regards,
Sara Khan
Project Manager, FleetTrack 2.0
